examples.en: We ran an online schema change with gh-ost, so the table stayed writable the whole time.
examples.zh: 我们用 gh-ost 做了在线表结构变更，整个过程表一直可写。

situation.zh: 面试官问：给一张五亿行的表加字段，怎么做到不锁表？
situation.en: I'd do an online schema change: build a shadow copy of the table, keep it in sync, and swap it in.

entries.note: 也说 online DDL。常用工具：gh-ost、pt-online-schema-change。schema 读 /ˈskiːmə/。

examples.en: Every schema change goes through a migration script that's reviewed and checked into the repo.
examples.zh: 每次表结构变更都要走迁移脚本，经过评审并提交到仓库里。

situation.zh: 同事直接在生产库上手动执行了 ALTER。你想提醒他按流程来：
situation.en: Could you put that in a migration script? Otherwise staging and production will drift apart.

entries.note: 常用工具：Flyway、Liquibase、Alembic。migration 既指表结构迁移，也指数据迁移（data migration）。

examples.en: We add the field as a nullable column first, backfill it, then make it required.
examples.zh: 我们先把字段加成可为空的列，回填数据，再改成必填。

situation.zh: 面试官问：给大表加一个必填字段，怎么分步上线才安全？
situation.en: First add it as a nullable column, deploy code that writes it, backfill old rows, and only then add the NOT NULL constraint.

entries.note: 这种“先扩后收”的做法叫 expand and contract。

entries.zh: 双写（迁移期间新旧两边同时写，动词）

examples.en: During the migration we dual-write to the old and new tables and compare the results.
examples.zh: 迁移期间我们对新旧两张表双写，并比对结果。

situation.zh: 面试官问：把数据从旧库迁到新库，迁移过程中新产生的写入怎么办？
situation.en: We dual-write: every write goes to both databases until the new one is verified, then we switch reads over.

entries.note: 名词是 dual writes。两边的写入不是原子的，可能不一致，所以要配合数据比对。

examples.en: We use soft deletes, so a row is only marked with a deleted_at timestamp.
examples.zh: 我们用软删除，一行数据只是打上 deleted_at 时间戳。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户误删了数据要能恢复，表该怎么设计？
situation.en: I'd use a soft delete: set a deleted_at column instead of removing the row, and filter it out in queries.

entries.note: 可以当动词：soft-delete a row。反义是 hard delete。注意唯一索引要把已删除的行考虑进去。

entries.zh: 冷数据（很少被访问的旧数据）

examples.en: We moved cold data to cheaper storage and kept only the last ninety days in MySQL.
examples.zh: 我们把冷数据挪到了更便宜的存储上，MySQL 里只留最近九十天的。

situation.zh: 面试官问：订单表越来越大，但九成查询只看最近三个月，怎么优化？
situation.en: I'd separate hot data from cold data: keep recent orders in the main table and move the rest elsewhere.

entries.note: 反义是 hot data。“冷热分离”可以说 separate hot and cold data；分层存储叫 tiered storage。

examples.en: We archive orders older than two years into a separate table every night.
examples.zh: 我们每晚把两年以前的订单归档到另一张表里。

situation.zh: 同事问：三年前的日志表还留在主库里干什么？你建议挪走：
situation.en: Nobody queries it anymore. Let's archive it to object storage and drop it from the primary.

entries.note: ch 发 k 的音。名词也是 archive：an archive table。

examples.en: Our retention policy is ninety days for logs and seven years for financial records.
examples.zh: 我们的保留策略是日志留九十天，财务记录留七年。

situation.zh: 面试官问：事件表每天新增一亿行，磁盘迟早会满，怎么办？
situation.en: I'd define a retention policy, say thirty days, and have a job delete or archive anything older.

entries.note: 保留期是 retention period。按策略清掉过期数据说 purge：purge rows older than 30 days。

entries.zh: 表分区（在单个库内把一张大表按范围拆成多个分区）

examples.en: With table partitioning by month, deleting old data is just dropping a partition.
examples.zh: 按月做表分区之后，删旧数据只需要删掉一个分区。

situation.zh: 面试官问：日志表要按月清理，用 DELETE 删几千万行又慢又容易锁表，有更好的办法吗？
situation.en: I'd use table partitioning by month, so removing a month of data means dropping one partition.

entries.note: 和分库分表的区别：分区还在同一个数据库实例里。查询只扫相关的分区叫 partition pruning。

examples.en: Someone dropped the wrong table, so we had to restore from a backup.
examples.zh: 有人删错了表，我们只好从备份恢复。

examples.en: We practice restoring from a backup every quarter, because an untested backup isn't a backup.
examples.zh: 我们每个季度演练一次从备份恢复，因为没演练过的备份等于没有备份。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们怎么确认数据库的备份真的能用？
situation.en: We restore from a backup into a scratch environment every month and run checks against it.

entries.zh: 时间点恢复（恢复到任意指定时刻）

examples.en: With point-in-time recovery we rolled the database back to one minute before the bad deploy.
examples.zh: 靠时间点恢复，我们把数据库恢复到了那次有问题的发布前一分钟。

situation.zh: 面试官问：下午三点有人误执行了一条没带 WHERE 的 UPDATE，而备份是凌晨做的，怎么办？
situation.en: With point-in-time recovery: restore the nightly backup, then replay the logs up to just before three.

entries.note: 缩写 PITR。原理是全量备份加上重放日志（MySQL 的 binlog、PostgreSQL 的 WAL）。

entries.zh: 连接数打满（连接用光了）

examples.en: The database ran out of connections because every pod opened its own pool of fifty.
examples.zh: 数据库的连接数被打满了，因为每个 pod 都开了一个五十连接的池子。

situation.zh: 同事问：为什么新扩出来的实例一启动，数据库就开始拒绝连接？
situation.en: The database has run out of connections. Each instance holds its own pool, so scaling out pushed us past the limit.

entries.note: 也说 hit the connection limit。MySQL 的报错是 Too many connections。常见解法是在中间加一层连接池代理，比如 PgBouncer、ProxySQL。

examples.en: When the primary died, we promoted a replica and were back in under a minute.
examples.zh: 主库挂掉之后，我们把一个从库提升为主库，不到一分钟就恢复了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：主库所在的机器彻底坏了，你们怎么恢复写入？
situation.en: We promote a replica to primary and repoint the application at it.

entries.note: 完整搭配是 promote ... to primary。旧主库修好后作为从库重新加入：rejoin as a replica。

entries.zh: 核对（两边的）数据并把差异对平（r 开头的动词短语）

examples.en: After the failover we reconciled the data between the old primary and the new one.
examples.zh: 主从切换之后，我们核对了旧主库和新主库之间的数据。

situation.zh: 面试官问：主库宕机时有几笔写入还没同步到从库，切换之后怎么处理？
situation.en: We reconcile the data: diff the old primary against the new one and replay or fix the missing writes by hand.

entries.note: reconcile 读 /ˈrekənsaɪl/，名词是 reconciliation（财务上的“对账”也是这个词）。只比对不修复可以说 run a consistency check。

examples.en: InnoDB stores its indexes as B+ trees, so range scans just walk the leaf nodes.
examples.zh: InnoDB 的索引是 B+ 树，所以范围扫描只要顺着叶子节点走就行。

situation.zh: 面试官问：MySQL 的索引为什么适合做范围查询？
situation.en: Because it's a B+ tree: all the rows are in the leaf nodes, and the leaves are linked in sorted order.

entries.note: 读作 B plus tree。日常经常直接说 B-tree，读作 B tree，中间的横线不读。

entries.zh: LSM 树（日志结构合并树）

examples.en: RocksDB uses an LSM tree, which turns random writes into sequential ones.
examples.zh: RocksDB 用的是 LSM 树，它把随机写变成了顺序写。

situation.zh: 面试官问：写入量特别大的场景，为什么很多存储引擎不用 B+ 树？
situation.en: They use an LSM tree instead: writes go to memory first and are flushed to disk as sorted files, which is much cheaper.

entries.note: LSM 逐字母读，全称 log-structured merge-tree。内存里的部分叫 memtable，磁盘上的文件叫 SSTable，后台合并文件叫 compaction。代价是一次读可能要查多个文件。

examples.en: We didn't lose anything in the crash because every commit was already in the write-ahead log.
examples.zh: 那次崩溃我们什么都没丢，因为每次提交都已经写进了预写日志。

situation.zh: 面试官问：数据库刚提交完事务就断电了，数据页还没写到磁盘，为什么数据不会丢？
situation.en: Because the change was written to the write-ahead log first, and the database replays it on restart.

entries.note: 缩写 WAL，当一个词读，和 wall 同音。MySQL InnoDB 里对应的是 redo log。

entries.zh: 刷盘（把内存里的数据写到磁盘）

examples.en: We flush to disk on every commit, which is slower but means we never lose acknowledged writes.
examples.zh: 我们每次提交都刷盘，慢一些，但已确认的写入绝不会丢。

situation.zh: 面试官问：为了提高写入性能，把日志改成每秒落一次盘，有什么风险？
situation.en: If the machine crashes, we lose up to a second of commits, because they hadn't been flushed to disk yet.

entries.note: 底层的系统调用是 fsync。及物用法：flush the log to disk、flush dirty pages。

examples.en: Write latency spiked every few minutes, and it lined up with the database's checkpoints.
examples.zh: 写入延迟每隔几分钟就飙一次，时间正好和数据库的检查点对上。

situation.zh: 面试官问：预写日志一直在追加，重启恢复时难道要从头重放吗？
situation.en: No. Recovery starts from the last checkpoint, because everything before it is already in the data files.

entries.note: 做检查点时会把脏页（dirty pages）刷到数据文件里。崩溃恢复是 crash recovery。

entries.zh: 有序集合（Redis 的数据结构）

examples.en: We keep the leaderboard in a Redis sorted set, with the score as the ranking key.
examples.zh: 排行榜我们放在 Redis 的有序集合里，用分数来排名。

situation.zh: 面试官问：实时排行榜要支持更新分数和取前一百名，用 Redis 的哪种结构？
situation.en: A sorted set. Updating a score is logarithmic, and reading the top hundred is a simple range query.

entries.note: 相关命令以 Z 开头（ZADD、ZRANGE）。其他常用结构：string、hash、list、set、stream。

entries.zh: RDB 快照（Redis 某一时刻的全量持久化文件）

examples.en: Redis forks a child process to write the RDB snapshot, so memory usage can spike.
examples.zh: Redis 会 fork 一个子进程来写 RDB 快照，所以内存占用可能会突然升高。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Redis 重启后数据是怎么恢复的？只靠定时全量落盘有什么问题？
situation.en: It loads the latest RDB snapshot. The downside is that we lose every write made since that snapshot was taken.

entries.note: RDB 逐字母读。两次快照之间的写入会丢，所以常和 AOF 一起开。

entries.zh: 仅追加文件（Redis 逐条记录写命令的持久化方式）

examples.en: We enabled the append-only file with fsync every second to limit data loss.
examples.zh: 我们开了 AOF，每秒 fsync 一次，把数据丢失控制在一秒左右。

situation.zh: 面试官问：想让 Redis 宕机时最多只丢一秒左右的数据，持久化怎么配？
situation.en: Turn on the append-only file and fsync it every second, so Redis logs each write command and replays them on restart.

entries.note: 缩写 AOF。文件会越写越大，Redis 会定期重写来压缩它（AOF rewrite）。

examples.en: We rely on key expiration to clean up sessions, so we never delete them by hand.
examples.zh: 会话我们靠键过期来清理，从来不手动删。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Redis 里一个键到期了，内存是立刻释放的吗？
situation.en: Not necessarily. Key expiration is lazy on access, plus a background task that samples and deletes expired keys.

entries.note: 动词是 expire：the key expires after ten minutes。Redis 文档把这两种方式叫 passive 和 active expiration，对应中文说的惰性删除和定期删除。

entries.zh: 内存达到上限（h 开头的动词短语）

examples.en: When Redis hit the memory limit, it started evicting keys we still needed.
examples.zh: Redis 的内存达到上限之后，开始淘汰我们还要用的键。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Redis 配成了不淘汰任何键，内存用满之后会发生什么？
situation.en: Once it hits the memory limit, writes fail with an out-of-memory error, while reads still work.

entries.note: Redis 里这个上限由 maxmemory 配置，“不淘汰”对应的策略名是 noeviction。淘汰键说 evict keys。

entries.zh: 没有固定表结构的（NoSQL 的特点，形容词）

examples.en: MongoDB is schemaless, so the application code has to cope with documents in different shapes.
examples.zh: MongoDB 没有固定的表结构，所以应用代码得自己处理各种形状的文档。

situation.zh: 面试官问：文档库不用提前定义字段，这是纯优点吗？
situation.en: Not really. Being schemaless just moves the schema into the application, so we still validate documents on write.

entries.note: ch 发 k。也写作 schema-less；更准确的说法是 flexible schema 或 schema-on-read。

entries.zh: 内嵌文档（文档库里嵌在父文档中的子文档）

examples.en: We store the line items as embedded documents, so one read returns the whole order.
examples.zh: 我们把订单明细存成内嵌文档，这样读一次就能拿到整张订单。

situation.zh: 面试官问：在 MongoDB 里，订单和它的明细是放在一起，还是分成两个集合？
situation.en: I'd keep the items as embedded documents, since they're always read with the order and the list is small.

entries.note: 另一种做法是 reference（只存 ID，引用另一个集合）。动词是 embed：embed the items in the order。

examples.en: We picked a wide-column store for the event log because it handles huge write volumes.
examples.zh: 事件日志我们选了宽列存储，因为它能扛住巨大的写入量。

situation.zh: 面试官问：每天几十亿条写入、按设备 ID 加时间范围查询，你会选哪类数据库？
situation.en: A wide-column store like Cassandra: writes are cheap, and rows are sorted by time within each partition.

entries.note: 也叫 wide-column database。别和列式存储（columnar storage）混淆，那是分析型数据库的存储方式。

examples.en: We tried a graph database for friend-of-friend queries, which were painful to write in SQL.
examples.zh: 我们试过用图数据库做“好友的好友”这类查询，这种查询用 SQL 写很痛苦。

situation.zh: 面试官问：要查两个用户之间最短的关系链，关系型数据库要连很多层表，有更合适的存储吗？
situation.en: A graph database like Neo4j fits better, because traversing relationships is what it's built for.

entries.note: 节点是 node（也叫 vertex），关系是 edge 或 relationship；多跳查询说 multi-hop traversal。

examples.en: We store metrics in a time-series database, which compresses them far better than PostgreSQL did.
examples.zh: 指标数据我们存在时序数据库里，压缩效果比原来用 PostgreSQL 好得多。

situation.zh: 面试官问：几万台机器每十秒上报一次 CPU 指标，这些数据存哪儿？
situation.en: In a time-series database like Prometheus or InfluxDB, since the data is append-only and queried by time range.

entries.note: 书面常缩成 TSDB。降低旧数据的精度叫 downsampling。

examples.en: We moved full-text search out of MySQL and into Elasticsearch once LIKE queries got too slow.
examples.zh: LIKE 查询慢得受不了之后，我们把全文检索从 MySQL 挪到了 Elasticsearch。

situation.zh: 面试官问：用户要按关键词搜商品标题和描述，直接在数据库里模糊匹配行不行？
situation.en: Not at scale. I'd use a dedicated full-text search engine and sync the data into it.

examples.en: Search is fast because we look terms up in an inverted index instead of scanning documents.
examples.zh: 搜索之所以快，是因为我们是在倒排索引里查词，而不是去扫文档。

situation.zh: 面试官问：搜索引擎为什么能在几亿篇文档里毫秒级找到包含某个词的文档？
situation.en: It uses an inverted index, which maps each term to the list of documents that contain it.

entries.note: 每个词对应的那个文档列表叫 posting list。

examples.en: We switched to a Chinese tokenizer, and search relevance improved right away.
examples.zh: 我们换了一个中文分词器，搜索的相关性马上就好了。

situation.zh: 同事问：为什么搜“手机”会出来一堆不相干的结果？
situation.en: The default tokenizer splits Chinese text into single characters, so it matches any document containing either character.

entries.note: 分词这个动作是 tokenization，切出来的词是 token。Elasticsearch 里 tokenizer 是 analyzer 的一部分。

examples.en: We boost the title field so that title matches get a higher relevance score.
examples.zh: 我们给标题字段加了权重，这样标题命中的结果相关性得分更高。

situation.zh: 面试官问：搜索结果默认是按什么排序的？
situation.en: By relevance score. Elasticsearch uses BM25, which considers term frequency and how rare the term is.

entries.note: 按相关性排序说 rank by relevance，名词是 relevance ranking。给某个字段加权说 boost。

entries.zh: 重建索引（把数据重新写入搜索索引，动词）

examples.en: Changing the mapping meant we had to reindex all forty million documents.
examples.zh: 改映射意味着我们得把四千万篇文档全部重建索引。

situation.zh: 面试官问：Elasticsearch 里已有字段的类型定错了，能直接改吗？
situation.en: No. We have to create a new index with the right mapping and reindex the data into it.

entries.note: 配合别名（alias）可以不停机切换：reindex into a new index, then switch the alias。

entries.zh: 联机事务处理（四字母缩写）

examples.en: Our OLTP database handles short transactions, so we keep heavy reports away from it.
examples.zh: 我们的 OLTP 库处理的是短事务，所以重型报表不放在它上面跑。

situation.zh: 面试官问：下单、支付这种每次只读写几行、但并发很高的负载，属于哪一类？
situation.en: That's an OLTP workload: lots of small transactions that each touch a few rows.

entries.note: 逐字母读，全称 online transaction processing。

entries.zh: 联机分析处理（四字母缩写）

examples.en: We run OLAP queries on a separate cluster so they never slow down the production database.
examples.zh: 我们在单独的集群上跑 OLAP 查询，这样它们绝不会拖慢生产库。

situation.zh: 面试官问：扫几亿行做聚合的报表查询，和线上交易查询有什么本质不同？
situation.en: Those are OLAP queries: they scan a lot of rows but only a few columns, so they need a different storage layout.

entries.note: 一般当一个词读 /ˈoʊlæp/，全称 online analytical processing。

examples.en: With columnar storage, the query only reads the three columns it needs, not the whole row.
examples.zh: 用列式存储的话，查询只读它需要的那三列，而不是整行。

situation.zh: 面试官问：分析型数据库的聚合查询为什么比 MySQL 快那么多？
situation.en: Mainly columnar storage: values of the same column are stored together, so they compress well and scans skip unused columns.

entries.note: columnar 读 /kəˈlʌmnər/。也说 column-oriented storage，对应 row-oriented。代表：ClickHouse、Parquet 文件格式。

examples.en: We load order data into the data warehouse every hour for the analytics team.
examples.zh: 我们每小时把订单数据导入数据仓库，给分析团队用。

situation.zh: 产品经理想直接连生产库跑复杂报表。你想建议他换个地方查：
situation.en: Please run that against the data warehouse instead. It has the same data, an hour behind, and won't affect production.

entries.note: 把数据抽取、转换、加载进去的流程叫 ETL pipeline。代表产品：Snowflake、BigQuery、Redshift。

entries.zh: 预聚合（提前把汇总结果算好，动词）

examples.en: We pre-aggregate page views by hour, so the dashboard doesn't scan the raw events.
examples.zh: 我们按小时对浏览量做预聚合，这样看板就不用去扫原始事件了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：看板要展示过去一年每天的订单数，每次都从明细表现算太慢，怎么办？
situation.en: I'd pre-aggregate the daily counts into a summary table and have the dashboard read from that.

entries.note: 存放结果的表叫 summary table 或 rollup table。
